# Once In A Blue Moon

> > A personal knowledge hub blending productivity tools, wellness guides, fashion advice, and thoughtful essays on health, learning, and personal development.

Once In A Blue Moon is a curated collection of practical guides, interactive tools, and reflective content covering wellness, style, productivity, and personal growth. The site combines educational resources with personal development insights, drawing from sources like Johns Hopkins and Cleveland Clinic for health information.

## Key Topics

- 72-hour fasting
- Intermittent fasting
- Feminine fashion
- Style guide
- Wardrobe basics
- Task management
- Spaced repetition learning
- Flexibility training
- Carbohydrate metabolism
- Personal development
- Decision-making
- Sapiens
- Yuval Noah Harari
- WordPress integration
- Educational streaming

## Core Tools & Platforms

- [Hey there!](https://www.onceinabluemoon.ca/splash): Welcome splash page introducing Once In A Blue Moon site
- [To Do List](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/to-do-list): Task Manager tool for productivity and priority management
- [Online Flash Card App](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/online-flash-card-app): Flash Card App using spaced repetition for learning and studying
- [Arcturus Radio](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/arcturus-radio): Arcturus Radio streaming platform for educational content and entertainment
- [Text](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/text): WordPress integration tool for content organization and filtering

## Health & Wellness Guides

- [The Benefits of a 72 Hour Fast](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/the-benefits-of-a-72-hour-fast): Health guide on 72-hour fasting benefits including autophagy and ketones
- [Is a 72 Hour Fast Healthy?](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/is-a-72-hour-fast-healthy): Health guide examining safety and risks of 72-hour fasting
- [How fast does the body digest and recover from one gram of sugar, and what if the body already has enough carbs?](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/how-fast-does-the-body-digest-and-recover-from-one-gram-of-sugar-and-what-if-the-body-already-has-enough-carbs): Nutrition physiology guide on sugar digestion and carbohydrate metabolism
- [Seated Pike Stretch: A Daily Guide for Improving Flexibility](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/seated-pike-stretch-a-daily-guide-for-improving-flexibility): Daily stretching guide for hamstring and lower back flexibility

## Fashion & Style

- [Embracing Femininity: A Guide to Dressing Feminine](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/embracing-femininity-a-guide-to-dressing-feminine): Style guide for feminine fashion and wardrobe basics

## Personal Development & Essays

- [We Are the Sum of Our Choices](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/we-are-the-sum-of-our-choices): Personal development article on decision-making and accountability
- [Lessons from the Book Sapiens by Yuval Noah Harari](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/lessons-from-the-book-sapiens-by-yuval-noah-harari): Book summary of Sapiens by Yuval Noah Harari on human history
